requirements.text: В списке продуктов отображается контактный email поставщика для продуктов, связанных с поставщиком.
notes: This slice starts from a successful supplier display/filter baseline: Product already has optional supplier_id, supplier_name display, and supplier filter behavior.
Supplier records must already be available through /api/suppliers or existing schema-compatible mock storage; this slice must not recreate supplier management or change the Supplier schema.
The contact email displayed for a product must come from the supplier currently assigned to that product, using real supplier ids/contact_email values from the current API or runtime test data.
If the product supplier is changed during edit, the displayed contact email must update to the newly selected supplier's contact_email.
